patch_description: Strengthen the SG stage: lower poly_order to 2 and enlarge sg_window to 2*window_size-1 (kept odd), while steepening the exponential recency weighting to np.exp(np.linspace(-1.5, 0.0, window_size)) to compensate the added group delay. Current correlation is 0.78 vs ~0.93 achievable, but smoothness (0.33) and noise_reduction (0.33) are binding constraints. The recency-weighted convolution is the proven lag-compensation mechanism; slope extrapolation consistently failed in prior generations.
